machine.type: bench fume-hood synthesis train per the node sizing/design blocks and duty section 3: borosilicate glass-lined reactor column (OD 150 x 600, 2 L working volume, node sizing throughput_g_d 9 at the bench class) with heating-jacket band (190 x 300); 3 SS304 reagent feed tanks (OD 200 x 300, CH3OH / H2S / NH3 per the schedule feeds); Hastelloy C crystalliser (OD 220 x 350, duty section 3: the product-quality bottleneck, X-UI-002); PTFE-lined transfer lines; metering pumps and stirrer drive as purchased-class envelopes
